blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing GHSm token has no direct governance-controlled blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Broker/exchange burn and Celo-VM gas debiting are protocol-scoped, not governance holder-freeze controls. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is a governance surface but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Celo block 74317848. GHSm 0xfaea5f3404bba20d3cc2f8c4b0a888f55a3c7313 still returned Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147 as owner, Broker 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and a zero exchange; its implementation remained verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Verified transfer paths have no blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, allowlist, or governance transfer hook. Broker/exchange burn is caller-scoped and debitGasFees is Celo-VM scoped. Mento governance can replace implementation only through the observed 172800-second timelock, so current direct blacklistability is false while deployment posture remains restrictable. USDC, USDT, EURC, and related shared-reserve exposures can impair backing but cannot restrict GHSm balances and are therefore dependency risk, not an inherited direct-access verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: At Celo block 78986505, GHSm's Broker/BiPoolManager USDm/GHSm ConstantSum exchange 0x3562f9d29eba092b857480a82b03375839c752346b9ebe93a57ab82410328187 uses GHS/USD feed 0x44d99a013a0dadbb4c06f9cc9397bfd3ac12b017, one ChainlinkRelayerV1 reporter 0x1485c0e710ff9ef059834f42b312f10e7af823bd, and one configured Chainlink aggregator 0x2719b648db57c5601bd4cb2ea934dec6f4262cd8. getRates and medianRate agree on 85344620000000000000000/1e24; medianTimestamp is 1790887033. Effective report expiry and bucket reset are 360 seconds, minimumReports is 1, and spread is 1%. MedianDeltaBreaker is enabled at 4% with a 900-second reset cooldown; ValueDeltaBreaker is disabled. The sorted-list median of one relayer is not independent medianization or failover. Stale reports invalidate ConstantSum quotes; BreakerBox suspends execution rather than substituting a second source. This evidenced single-live-source topology retains the existing Mento single-source-or-laggy convention; it does not assert the pinned report was stale.

branchApplicability.rationale: GHSm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
